{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species, automatically excluding missing values
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the mean for each species
print("Mean flipper length by species:")
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Find and print the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f"Species with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}")

# Extract and print the value for the highest species
highest_mean_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()
print(f"Highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_value:.2f} mm")"}
